releaseNotes:
ReVa v5.0.0.0 - Major Release & Android Native Build!

✨ New Features & Improvements:
• Full ReVa app rebranding
• In-app GitHub release updater & Account/Settings screen
• Fund transfer between accounts & cash note tracking
• Snack & loan management fixes and real-time validations
• Native Android Material 3 bottom navigation, haptics & gestures
• Hardware back button support & offline status indicator
• Stability and performance optimizations across all dashboards
